attempted_claim: Fix an odd prime p>2 and a finite ramified extension K/Q_p with ramification index e>=2 and residue field k. Fix a finite extension E/Q_p with integers O and residue field F, and a continuous rbar:G_K->GL_2(F) whose semisimplification is, up to an unramified twist psi, rbar^{ss} ~= psi (+) psi*chibar_cyc^{-1}, i.e. the two-dimensional non-cyclotomic-free case in the sense of Bartlett, Definition 1.1.1(2). Fix a pseudo-Barsotti-Tate Hodge type mu=(mu_{kappa_{ij}}) in the sense of Bartlett, Definition 1.1.1(1): for a suitable indexing kappa_{ij} of embeddings K->Qbar_p with kappa_{ij}|_k=kappa_{i'j'}|_k iff i=i', mu_{kappa_{ij}} subset [0,h_j] with h_1=p and h_2=...=h_e=1. Prove that every crystalline lift V of rbar of Hodge type mu is potentially diagonalisable in the sense of BLGGT: after some finite K'/K, V|_{G_{K'}} lies on the same irreducible component of Spec R^mu_{rbar} as a direct sum of crystalline characters. In particular prove the corresponding two-sided crystalline R=T / BLGGT-type automorphy lifting criterion for global lifts of this fixed residual type and fixed pseudo-Barsotti-Tate weight range.
decisive_failure: No complete or partial auditable theorem is claimed. The base-change stability observation is an elementary definitional consequence, not an independently valuable finding. A weaker ordinary or split-reducible sub-locus connectivity statement was identified but not proved and would not imply the admitted two-sided R=T criterion. All conclusions rest on local proof-structure analysis without literature retrieval.
